# Case Index {#sec-appendix-g}

This index lists the 31 documented cases the book analyzes: by chapter, by field and by failure type. The failure label follows the Failure Taxonomy Tree (Chapter 4): *documented* means the record shows the branch's defining feature, *inferred* means it does not; "chain link" refers to the failure-to-harm chain. Cases in which no output was wrong (input-side harms, policies, training-data disputes, positive results) are not placed on the tree.
